content: Hello all! I'm Dean, a master's student at Stanford in math and computer science. I've been writing Lean for about two years and working in autoformalization for one. Happy to be here and excited to work with everyone!
I've also just opened my first PR to Mathlib (#41953), adding Levent Alpöge's recent counterexample to the Jacobian conjecture to the Counterexamples library. I'd appreciate any feedback!
This is currently discussed here. I suggest people coordinate the work, and since we need to chose one official statement, I would go for the formal conjecture one.
Ahh so sorry did not think to check that channel, looks like I was late! Thanks for linking the formal conjectures PR; I'll close mine and get to work on golfing there
